working_on.feature: DOM Bridge Diagnostic & Debug Logger Subsystem
working_on.task: Completed Phase 04: Export Diagnostics Commands & Webview 1-Click Integration
working_on.notes: All 4 phases of DOM Bridge Diagnostic & Debug Logger Subsystem fully implemented and verified with single file-based test suites.

recent_changes.description: Completed Phase 04: Export Diagnostics Commands & Webview 1-Click Integration. Added autoplan.copyDebugLog, autoplan.exportDebugLog, autoplan.clearDebugLog, autoplan.showOutputChannel, Live Log Viewer Console in Settings Panel, quick-copy in Sidebar footer, and direct diagnostic copy in failure toasts.
Completed Phase 03: Deep Electron DOM Diagnostic Engine in media/autoplan-dom-bridge.js and src/workbenchInjector.ts.
Completed Phase 02: BridgeServer Log Ingestion API (/log) and IPC multi-tier tracing.
Completed Phase 01: Core DebugLogger subsystem and dedicated VS Code Log Output Channel.

errors_encountered.error: ReferenceError: document is not defined when requiring media/settings/settings.js in Node.js test runner
errors_encountered.solution: Added safe fallback mock for document and window at the head of settings.js when running in headless Node.js environment.

errors_encountered.error: SettingsProvider clearDebugLog only cleared global logger instance instead of injected instance
errors_encountered.solution: Updated handleMessage clearDebugLog case to clear this._logger, send updated buffer, and dispatch command.

decisions_made: Use bounded ring buffer (500 entries) in memory to prevent memory bloat while allowing instant report compilation
Provide dedicated VS Code Log Output Channel ('Auto-Plan DOM Bridge') for live trace streaming
Support 1-click clipboard copy from failure notification toasts without navigating away
Add collapsible full-width live log viewer console in Settings Panel with level filtering and auto-scroll
